# The Hope Diamond’s Two-Day Journey to the Smithsonian

In 1958, jeweler Harry Winston donated the 45.5-carat Hope Diamond to the Smithsonian. The gem began its journey from New York’s General Post Office on November 8, packed in a plain brown package and sent by registered first-class mail.

The postage cost $2.44, and registration cost $142.85. The diamond arrived at the Smithsonian on November 10, in time for a presentation ceremony attended by Postmaster General Arthur Summerfield.
